# `aitbc config path`

Show the path to the local or global configuration file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config path [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--global` | flag | `false` | no | Show global config |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config path
```
